Question:
What can be said about the distances from points on a circle to its center?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p188_q1_question_en.svg)

Choices.A: The distances all equal the radius
Choices.B: Some are longer and some are shorter

Solution: All radii of the same circle have the same length.
